Discover Kapoor Kachri Powder

Kapoor kachri powder is made from the dried rhizome of Hedychium spicatum, also called spiked ginger lily. Tradenest Naturals supplies it to cosmetic, herbal and fragrance brands that buy in bulk. The roots are cleaned, dehydrated and milled into a fine powder with a warm, camphor-like scent. As a kapoor kachri powder exporter, we focus on even texture and a steady aroma from lot to lot. Hair care and herbal product makers are our main buyers. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, so you can check the details before ordering. Contact us to request a quote or sample.

Manufacturing and Processing

Our process starts with careful raw material selection. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers and collectors. We clean the roots, dehydrate them and mill them under hygienic conditions. Gentle milling gives an even particle size and helps keep the natural aroma. Each lot is checked for colour, scent, texture and moisture before packing. As a kapoor kachri powder manufacturer india, we combine traditional herbal knowledge with modern equipment. Our team follows food hygiene practices under our FSSAI licence. Lot records are kept from raw root to packed bag.

Quality Assurance and Technical Specifications

Clear information is part of our service. Our bulk kapoor kachri powder supplier work follows the hygiene practices required for a licensed food business. We keep batch records, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our standard grade is dehydrated, milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture at or below 10%. Our packing protects the powder from moisture and contamination in transit. Shelf life is 24 months in cool, dry storage. Ask us for the full specification sheet.

Applications in Cosmetics and Herbal Industries

Kapoor kachri powder is used in several sectors. Cosmetic brands use it in hair oils, hair masks and herbal shampoos, mainly for its natural fragrance. Herbal makers include it in traditional Ayurvedic blends. Wholesale kapoor kachri powder buyers also use it in incense, bath powders and ubtan-style face packs. Whether you make hair masks or skin care products, the fine texture blends easily. We can also help with pack sizes for your project.

Buyer Value and Supply Partnership

Choosing Tradenest Naturals as your kapoor kachri powder wholesale partner gives you clear terms and steady supply. We offer fair pricing, OEM and private label packing, and export documentation support as an IEC registered exporter. What is the minimum order quantity for kapoor kachri powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer bulk bags and retail pouches, with a shelf life of 24 months. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on order size and destination, and samples can be requested through our website. We ship worldwide from India.
